summary: FRONTEND-ONLY responsive + regression sweep on Meraaj Network via public URL with real Playwright viewport emulation. Verified: (1) no horizontal overflow on 10 viewports (320/360/375/390/412/430 mobile + 1024/1280/1440/1920 desktop) across /, /login, /register, /market, /market/:id, /dashboard, /wallet, /packages, /packages/new (seller), /bookings, /admin, /admin/offices (admin) — 100% pass, documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth on every combination; (2) booking + wallet-topup dialogs fit inside 360x800 and 320x640 viewports (left>=0, right<=innerWidth), close button visible, action buttons reachable (dialog scrolls internally at 320px); (3) market cards use aspect ratio 1.333 (4/3) with object-fit:cover and images never exceed card width at 360 and 1440; (4) RTL: body direction rtl, Arabic headings wrap (no text overflow found anywhere on /market and /market/:id), prices/dates render RTL-correct; (5) market filters (search, sort, min/max price, date from/to, duration-mid, feature-breakfast, reset) all update market-result-count identically at 360 and 1440, reset restores 40; (6) room selection pricing: guest and B2C individual → room-select-quad gives pkg-main-price and booking-total 1,100.00, room-select-double gives 1,500.00 (PASS). For an OFFICE buyer booking-total is the B2B net+commission figure (1,020 / 715) — expected business logic, not a bug; (7) guest public browsing shell (public-login-btn) and open-booking-btn redirect to /login?next=/market/<id> (PASS); (8) idle auto-lock with QA override meraaj_idle_ms=3000 → redirect to /login, meraaj_resume_route == /market/6a8a927e2a21d40801ce8f68, re-login lands back on that deep route and clears the key (PASS); (9) hard refresh on deep route → /dashboard (individual) and /admin (super_admin) (PASS); in-app drawer nav still works (nav-market); (10) manual logout does NOT set resume route → next login lands on /dashboard (PASS); (11) /admin/offices has 'واتساب' column and green whatsapp-<id> anchors with href https://wa.me/<digits>?text=<urlencoded Arabic> (855 buttons over 885 rows, all href formats valid).

ui_bugs.issue: Broken external image renders as broken-image icon inside the 4/3 card: https://rahaal.targetmediagrp.com/api/meraaj/packages/9002/image returns no image (naturalWidth=0). No onError fallback to the placeholder used for image-less packages.

issues: Native browser date inputs are used (placeholder shows LTR 'mm/dd/yyyy') inside a strictly RTL Arabic UI instead of the shadcn calendar/date picker — inconsistent localization; date format is US-style.
Table is 1295px wide inside an overflow-x:auto wrapper (no page-level overflow, acceptable) but the واتساب/actions columns require horizontal scrolling on mobile; consider a card layout for <640px.
885 office rows are rendered in one DOM pass with no pagination/virtualization — noticeable render cost on mobile.

action_items: Add an img onError fallback (placeholder) for package card/hero images so dead Rahaal image URLs (e.g. package 9002) don't show a broken-image icon.
Optional: replace native <input type=date> with the shadcn calendar (or force ar locale) in market filters and create-package for RTL consistency.
Optional: paginate/virtualize /admin/offices (885 rows) and provide a mobile card layout.
critical_code_review_comments: PackageDetail.js: booking DialogContent overrides with 'max-w-lg max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto' while dialog.jsx base already sets 'w-[calc(100%-2rem)] max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' — duplicate/conflicting utility classes; rely on the base for consistency.
PackageDetail.js is 352 lines with the whole booking dialog inline; extract BookingDialog and the pricing (chargeOf/pick) helpers to keep it maintainable.

SessionManager idle timer resets on any window event but the QA override localStorage key 'meraaj_idle_ms' is read once per effect run — fine for QA, but consider gating it behind a non-production flag so it cannot be abused in prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested scenarios passed (only 1 low-severity broken external image + 2 design nits)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing accounts buyer@test.com, seller@test.com, user1@qa-example.com, abuzay84@gmail.com. No bookings/topups were submitted (dialogs only opened and closed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive/overflow, dialog fit, RTL, market filters, room pricing, guest guard, idle-lock/resume, hard-refresh→home and admin WhatsApp column were all verified green at iteration 9 (July 2026). Note: booking-total for role=office is intentionally net+10% commission (1,020 double / 715 quad), so assert 1,500/1,100 only with a B2C individual or guest. Mobile sidebar nav links exist in the DOM but are off-canvas — click data-testid='menu-open-btn' before nav-* links at <1024px. Backend was not exercised in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Broken card image: the package sourced from Rahaal stores an absolute image URL (rahaal.targetmediagrp.com/api/meraaj/packages/9002/image) that currently 404s; the JSX only falls back to the placeholder when images[0] is absent, not when loading fails, so the browser paints its broken-image glyph.
